verdict.rationale: Delegation through representatives and powers of attorney is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no published authorization forms, representative roles, or rules on which signatures must stay personal. The signature-card references describe filing routes (DPMAdirektPro vs. DPMAdirektWeb), not what a third party may do on the applicant's behalf, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
